title: Content Studio
subtitle: Local project files · catalogs · explicit publishing
invalidDrafts: Invalid field drafts block preview and export: {fields}
replaceDescription: Unsaved layout, catalog or context edits will be replaced. Published content remains unchanged.
documentDraft: Unapplied JSON draft. Canvas shows the last applied document.
documentCurrent: Current raw document. Variables and bindings are preserved.
canvasChanged: The canvas changed after this JSON draft began. Applying replaces the canvas session.
inputNotApplied: Unapplied input. The viewer shows the current working copy.
contextDraft: Unapplied context draft. Canvas uses the last applied context.
contextCurrent: Non-copy context is saved inside the complete project file.
previewUnconfigured: This host has not configured page preview.
previewBlocked: Apply drafts and fix errors before requesting a preview. Any visible frame is a previous snapshot.
previewStale: Previous preview snapshot. Refresh to see current content or theme.
previewIdle: Request a preview of the current valid document.
previewReady: Preview snapshot ready. Temporary previews expire after a few minutes.
exportFinished: {kind} download started for the submitted snapshot. Any newer changes still need export.
exportFailed: Download failed. No snapshot was marked as exported.
fileSaved: Local file saved. Newer edits may still need saving.
fileDownloaded: Download started. The original file has not been confirmed saved.
fileFailed: File operation failed. Your current work is preserved.
publicationCurrent: The submitted languages match the published snapshot.
publicationDirty: There are changes not published to the selected target.
sharedKeyNotice: Editing a shared key updates every referencing field.
referencedKey: Referenced keys must be unbound before deletion.
keyHelp: Use a dot path, or a JSON string array for literal dots.
unbindVariable: Use current value as direct value
unbindWarning: Direct values no longer follow language changes.
publishLoaded: Project retrieved. Confirm replacement if prompted; Save As creates a local working file.
publishSucceeded: Snapshot published. Local file save status is separate.
publishConflict: The target changed. Inspect or open its latest version before publishing again.
publishNotFound: No content exists at this target.
publishInvalid: Choose a target and fix the reported publication issues.
publishFailed: The target operation failed. Your current work is preserved.
publishConfirmBody: This updates the selected target. Local file saving remains a separate action.
pendingDrafts: Apply or repair visible JSON drafts before saving or publishing.
publishAttached: Target version linked. Your current project is preserved; Publish will replace the target content.
previewEmptyHelp: Add text, media or another visible element. Empty layout containers do not produce a page preview.
